projects.name: Qualcomm ELD Contributions
projects.summary: Two merged fixes in Qualcomm's LLVM-based ELF linker, improving GNU option compatibility and preventing linker-script crashes.
projects.flow: Object files + linker script → symbol and section layout → ELF executable
features: Accepted numeric GNU -O compatibility options while keeping LTO optimization controls independent.
Guarded ELF/program-header address assignment when a linker script omits those headers from the output layout.
Reproduced failures and added regression coverage for x86-64, Hexagon, ARM, AArch64, RV32, and RV64 configurations.
projects.notes: Focused validation covered x86-64, Hexagon, ARM, AArch64, RV32, and RV64 configurations, not the full ELD suite. Additional LTO, AArch64, and documentation changes remain under review.
highlights: GNU numeric -O compatibility with independent LTO optimization controls.
PHDRS/FILEHDR crash fix; focused regressions across 6 target configurations.

contributions.title: #2011 · GNU numeric -O compatibility
contributions.detail: Unblocked warning-sensitive Meson links while leaving --lto-O controls independent. Regression coverage across six target configurations.

contributions.title: #2065 · PHDRS/FILEHDR layout crash
contributions.detail: Guarded header address assignment when a linker script omits headers from the output layout; checked both header combinations.

contributions.title: #2129 · Native LTO saved objects
contributions.detail: Preserved native ARM/AArch64 object emission with --save-temps; covered full LTO, ThinLTO, and explicit assembly output.

contributions.title: #2134 · AArch64 feature flags
contributions.detail: Preserved BTI/PAC flags across multiple sections in one input. The regression failed before the fix; 18 focused runs passed after it.

contributions.title: #2127 · Contributor build guidance
contributions.detail: Documented LLVM main alignment and space-free source/build paths following hands-on WSL setup and maintainer discussion.

projects.name: Legal Lens 2.0
projects.summary: Contributed hybrid retrieval and a cited research assistant that connects legal questions to page-level evidence.
projects.flow: PDF pages → BM25 + MiniLM indexes → reciprocal rank fusion → cited answer or source excerpts
features: Combined lexical and semantic ranking with reciprocal rank fusion, keeping PDF page references attached to retrieved passages.
Added retrieval-augmented generation with page-linked citations and a document-excerpt fallback when generation is unavailable.
Implemented local scope/intent classification using MiniLM embeddings and logistic regression, plus cited research-brief export.
projects.notes: Built around a historical source corpus. Retrieval-quality and latency benchmarks are not claimed; the repository documents provider setup and reproduction.
highlights: BM25 + MiniLM with reciprocal rank fusion over a 1,871-page historical IPC source.
Cited answers, excerpt fallback, local intent classification, and research-brief export.

projects.name: Real Estate Aggregator
projects.summary: A property marketplace prototype with searchable listings, account workflows, payment integration, and PDF contracts.
projects.flow: PHP/Slim routes → account and property workflows → MySQL + payment/email/PDF integrations
features: Built listing creation/editing and filters for location, budget, availability, and amenities.
Implemented registration, login, email OTP/reset flows, and account views.
Added Razorpay order creation/signature checks, stored payment records, and TCPDF contract generation.
projects.notes: The repository documents setup and remaining authorization/payment-consistency work. This is a prototype, without a verified production payment deployment.
highlights: Location, budget, availability, and amenity filters backed by MySQL.
Razorpay order/signature handling, email OTP flows, and TCPDF contracts.

projects.name: GPT-2 Review Summarization
projects.summary: Fine-tuned GPT-2 to generate short Amazon review summaries, from data preparation to checkpointed inference.
projects.flow: Reviews → preprocessing and split → GPT-2 fine-tuning → checkpoint → summary generation
features: Prepared review–TL;DR–summary sequences with a custom dataset and data loaders.
Implemented an AdamW training loop, learning-rate scheduling, checkpoint save/load, and prompt-based generation.
Included ROUGE/BLEU evaluation code and documented prompt-leakage and batching issues that need correction.
projects.notes: Coursework experiment. Evaluation corrections are documented: historical ROUGE/BLEU scores are not valid quality measurements because of prompt leakage and batch-scoring issues. No benchmark result is claimed.
highlights: Custom PyTorch datasets and loaders for review–TL;DR–summary sequences.
AdamW training, learning-rate scheduling, checkpoint save/load, and generation.

projects.name: C++ Concepts & Systems Lab
projects.summary: Interactive C++ lessons and a C++17 filesystem lab exploring containers, recursive operations, and concurrency.
projects.flow: Concepts: lesson → simulation → editable code → compiler output. Systems: command parser → sequential/threaded commands → filesystem operations.
features: Created data-driven memory/container simulations that explain concepts step by step.
Connected the editor to Wandbox for C++, C, Java, and Python, separating compiler output from program output.
Added timed quizzes, a browser-local leaderboard, and sanitized Markdown for assistant responses.
Implemented command classes for cd, ls, cp, mv, and rm with recursive directory handling.
Compared sequential and threaded executables, coordinating listing output with a mutex.
Included workload-generation and timing scripts to explore filesystem and concurrency behavior.
projects.notes: Two complementary implementations: a browser learning app and an educational filesystem interpreter. Visuals are teaching simulations, not execution traces. Compilation and AI features require external services. Timing scripts explore concurrency; no measured speedup is claimed.
highlights: Step-through simulations, an editable compiler workspace, quizzes, and an optional Gemini tutor.
cd / ls / cp / mv / rm; sequential and threaded variants with synchronized output.
